subject: ela
intro: Pick the tool, skill, or step.

items.prompt:
You type words on a computer with the:
A) keyboard
B) window
C) wall

steps: Keys type letters. Key is A.

items.prompt:
A spell-checker helps you find:
A) spelling mistakes
B) the weather
C) the author

To make a paper copy, you:
A) print
B) sleep
C) run

steps: Printing makes a copy. Key is A.

items.prompt:
To give a classmate feedback on a shared document WITHOUT changing their words, you:
A) leave a comment
B) delete the file
C) print it

steps: Comments give feedback. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Typing efficiently is called:
A) keyboarding
B) coloring
C) napping

Before you close your file, you should:
A) save it
B) erase it
C) hide it

steps: Save to keep it. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Good keyboarding skills help a fifth grader:
A) type at least two pages in a single sitting
B) run faster
C) draw better
items.answer: A) type at least two pages in a single sitting

steps: Grade 5 typing goal. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) type at least two pages in a single sitting

items.prompt:
Two students write and comment on the same online document at once. This is:
A) collaborating with technology
B) printing
C) spell-checking

steps: Working together online. Key is A.
